subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: who are jolly those who have sound health are jolly sound mind lies in sound body minds become jolly when our life is filled with pleasure. Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: Who are jolly? Those who have sound health are jolly. Sound mind lies in sound body. Minds become jolly when our life is filled with pleasure.
